ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Interface scale
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
A Pickle step that sets the interface scale the way the Options page does, and the repair of Pickle's tag store that lets a click land at any scale but 100 percent. Developer tooling; no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See InterfaceScale/README.md at the repository root.
It carries the same change as the pull request proposed to Pickle itself; when that lands this mod can go.
Developer test companion for RimWorld 1.6. Requires Pickle; no gameplay content or scenarios included. Enable only for test suites that use these steps. Runtime coverage and limitations are documented in the repository.
